4ae924e6.text:
Your first stop should be Ironforge which can be reached via the technological marvel known as the Deeprun Tram.

You can find the entrance to the tram in the Dwarven District here in Stormwind, just to the southwest of the keep. The tram will transport you safely to the heart of Ironforge City.

Once you arrive, explore the city and locate High Tinker Mekkatorque and King Magni Bronzebeard in Tinker Town and the Great Forge, respectively. Introduce yourself as an agent of the $R and they will show you their hospitality.
4ae924e6.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions

5c8c56b7.text:
After you've become acquainted with the other leaders of the alliance, Lord Fordragon has requested that you report back to him here in the keep.

I wish you good fortune in your journeys, $R.
5c8c56b7.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions

79eb1dce.text:
The city of Darnassus can be found across the sea, off the coast of northern Kalimdor. The city itself rests at the top of the great tree, Teldrassil.

The safest route for you currently is via the harbor on the west side of Stormwind. Take the ship departing from the southernmost dock to the port of Auberdine.

Upon arriving, proceed to the north side of the Auberdine docks and take the ship there to Ru'theran Village. This village contains a magical transporter that will take you into the city itself.

Explore Darnassus and seek out Tyrande Whisperwind, the High Priestess of Elune.
79eb1dce.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions

ed4434f9.text:
Greetings,

As a guest of the Alliance, you have been given leave to travel freely throughout Alliance lands. 

This document will serve as a guide to help you reach the other member cities of our alliance.
ed4434f9.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions

1285|ed056522.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1285|fe52f4ea.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1286|ed056522.name: Edna Mullby
1286|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|6928abbf.name: John Burnside
2457|6928abbf.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256391|2130dab5.name: Elaine Compton
256391|2130dab5.text:
Not every order goes according to plan. While we strive to ensure that each delivery arrives intact and efficiently, a recent rise of beasts, bandits, and even Horde attacks, unfortunately causes some unavoidable loss of goods.

Should you find any lost shipments and are feeling particularly helpful, you can take a look over the label and identify its expected contents. It is not your responsibility to deal with our shortcomings of course, but if you complete the shipment, you will be rewarded in kind.

Ms. Baker near the crates will handle your compensation, and we will take care of the logistics from there.

256391|3090047f.name: Elaine Compton
256391|3090047f.text:
Oh goodness, you snuck up on me! Glad to see you, $N, the Azeroth Commerce Authority is always in need of new contractors.

If you are the sort to enjoy a stroll through the forest gathering useful materials or possess the skills to craft something from scratch, well, you have found yourself right at home!

Please let me know if you have any questions.

256391|4f7887c0.name: Elaine Compton
256391|4f7887c0.text:
Of course we trade in gold! It is a universal currency, after all.

However, we have our own system for exchanges made amongst ourselves. It is known as Merchant's Favor, and it effectively abstracts away the ever-fluctuating value of gold and silver. This ensures consistent, fair, and equitable trade between members of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Before you ask, no, it cannot be liquidated into gold.

We still use gold for simple trades such as basic threads or alchemy vials, you know - everyday crafts. Otherwise we rely on Merchant's Favor.

The more you help with our lost shipments and influx of crafting orders, the more Favor you will earn!

256391|8595984c.name: Elaine Compton
256391|8595984c.text:
We have rapidly expanded our business in recent months, but we are still developing the means to ensure swift communication between clients across all corners of the world. As such, we have to keep our eyes out for opportunities to keep our craftsmen's hands busy. We depend on couriers or other brave souls to bring crafting orders directly to us.

You can probably imagine that business model brings about challenges. In the meantime, we strongly encourage our crafters to satisfy these orders and deliver the goods directly to the customers themselves, wherever they may currently be. Fret not, friend, you will be fairly compensated for your troubles and earn our respect!

256729|06bc17cb.name: Nina Surefire
256729|06bc17cb.text:
I know what you're thinking, but don't worry, we keep our cooking and alchemy ingredients separate!

How can I help you?

256730|fb965f91.name: Stondry Darkhammer
256730|fb965f91.text: The ingots are for display only!

256732|9285f4a0.name: Alynsia
256732|9285f4a0.text: You look like you could use a few enchants. You have come to the right place!

256733|8265ab1b.name: Fritz Fizzle
256733|8265ab1b.text: Pleased to meet you! If you like to tinker, you have come to the right place!

256734|edaae191.name: Daniel Stitchsong
256734|edaae191.text: Hello there! I've got the finest leathers this side of Stormwind. Interested?

256735|8db10840.name: Mivin Shadowweave
256735|8db10840.text: <Mivin gestures toward his wares and back at you again with a smile, but says nothing.>

256742|424df33e.name: Dianne Softstep
256742|424df33e.text:
Ah, I am afraid you and I have no business at this time.

If you end up fulfilling some contracts with the trade authority, then perhaps we will have something to discuss later.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5504|e653c173.name: Sheldras Moontree
5504|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

7766|2849f8e9.name: Tyrion
7766|2849f8e9.text:
You'll have to be patient with me, $N. I've got my Spybot inside working on a very delicate matter. I'll be with ya in a second.

Oh, and do me a favor, try not to let Lescovar see you... we're about to ambush him.

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

166-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-complete.text:
$N, your bravery is remarkable.  The People's Militia thanks you for your service to the people of Westfall.  With VanCleef dead, this marks the beginning of the end for the Defias Brotherhood.  Hopefully some day soon peace will once again grace the plains of this fair land.

I salute you, Lady!
166-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

214-complete.name: Scout Riell
214-complete.text: Well done, $N!  On behalf of The People's Militia I salute you for your efforts.  Soon we will return this land to the people with help from brave souls like you.
214-complete.title: Red Silk Bandanas

214-progress.name: Scout Riell
214-progress.text: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang?  If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.
214-progress.title: Red Silk Bandanas

2745-complete.name: Tyrion
2745-complete.text:
What the...?! Don't sneak up on me like that! And keep your voice down! What in the name of the Shadow are you doing sneakin' up on me for? Can't you see I'm busy, you daft fool?

What do you mean, what am I doing? I'm waiting for the next Dark Portal to open, what the heck do you think I'm doing? Speak your peace and be off with you... 'fore the guards notice the two of us hiding in the bushes together. I have a reputation to maintain.
2745-complete.title: Infiltrating the Castle

2746-accept.name: Tyrion
2746-accept.text:
Trias wants the timetable pushed up some, huh? Okay, we can do that, but I'm not ready. And know this, I'm doing the hard part, but you're the one that's going to get her hands dirty, understand? Good.

Okay, I'll need you to get me a few things before I can put my plan into effect. I got the perfect disguise that'll get Spybot past those guards.

Bring me some silk and a couple apples. The silk's up to you, but Clara's little farm right outside the city has the perfect sized apples.
2746-accept.title: Items of Some Consequence

2746-complete.name: Tyrion
2746-complete.text:
These will do nicely, $N. Great job.

I have the rest of the gear I'll need in my pack... thank the Light I just got a tailor friend of mine to make me a silk bag. I was running out of room carrying all my gear around.

Before Spybot heads in, let's get the details set so you know what you have to do.
2746-complete.title: Items of Some Consequence

2746-progress.name: Tyrion
2746-progress.text:
I've been watching Lescovar for a couple weeks now. Trias has never trusted him, but we didn't suspect he was involved in anything to do with the Defias Brotherhood. We were following leads that tied him to the Twilight's Hammer. Either way, he's become more dangerous than this city can deal with, and that's where we come in.

Get me those items and we can put my plan into effect.
2746-progress.title: Items of Some Consequence

388-accept.name: Nikova Raskol
388-accept.text:
Bitterness flows through my veins like a cold river.  My grandson, Mac, was such a good boy.  A mere 14 years old.  When the army was sent off to the front, Mac took up arms to defend the city.  He was a guard in The Stockade, where the Defias gang is locked up.  Mac reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their wool blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang.  For that Mac was stabbed in the back.

I want revenge.  Bring me 10 of their precious Wool Bandanas.  They are the color of blood.
388-accept.title: The Color of Blood

434-accept.name: Tyrion
434-accept.text:
After I put on Spybot's disguise, he'll head in to talk to Lescovar. The guards should let him pass no problem.

While you were getting materials for me, I took care of informing Marzon that it was time for him and Lescovar to meet again. I even dropped some false information.

Lescovar will dismiss his guards and wait for Marzon out here in the garden. After you catch wind of talk about the Defias, make your move. You need to kill them both before the guards return! When you're done, speak to Trias.
434-accept.title: The Attack!

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247-progress.title: Shipping Label
